transcript.text: my oven fan keeps going after ive turned the oven off, been about 20 mins now. is it broken??

It is very likely not broken. Most modern ovens have a cooling fan that continues to run for 10–30 minutes after you switch off to protect the electronics from overheating; this is completely normal behaviour. To be sure we aren't missing a fault, could you tell me: is it the main fan inside the oven cavity (the one that circulates heat) or a quieter fan on the outside/top of the unit? Also, does it sound smooth and quiet, or is there any rattling, scraping or grinding noise?
not sure which fan it is, i just hear a steady whirr and warm air coming out the slot above the door. no rattling or grinding, just a normal hum

That suggests it is the cooling fan, and what you are hearing is completely normal. As long as the sound remains a steady hum without rattling or grinding, there is no fault here and you do not need to do anything further. If it ever continues running for more than an hour after switching off, or if you hear loud noises, then we would look at a mechanical issue.

candidates: Faulty oven control board or timer relay stuck closed (low)
